annotation.title_clean: 国务院就业促进和劳动保护工作领导小组关于印发《稳岗扩容提质行动方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the State Council Leading Group on Employment Promotion and Labor Protection on Issuing the Action Plan for Stabilizing Jobs, Expanding Capacity and Improving Quality
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院就业促进和劳动保护工作领导小组 (State Council Leading Group on Employment Promotion and Labor Protection)
annotation.summary_en: China's State Council employment leading group issues an action plan (30 April 2026) to stabilize and expand jobs across sectors. AI appears tangentially: AI-enabled industrial upgrading with retraining, the "AI+" initiative, new AI occupations such as data annotators, and AI skills training. No robot-specific governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Encourages firms adopting AI to provide retraining and job-transfer training to keep workers employed
Implements the 'AI+' action and expands new occupations like data annotators and AI trainers
Launches AI and technical skills training campaigns
Requires employment impact assessment before major projects and policies
Plans a measure protecting rights of workers in new forms of employment
